provenance.author: NC-01 golden short mirrors (Claude)
provenance.notes: Short mirror of G-STOP-L-01: market reflected around the base price, signals and side flipped. ATR 1. Entry 100 x 0.9998 = 99.98, stop 101.98, qty 5 (risk 10 / 2). Candle 282 (green, o->l->h->c) reaches 102.5. Exchange stop-market buy fills at 101.98 x 1.0002 = 102.000396; R = ((99.98 - 102.000396) x 5 - 5 x (99.98 + 102.000396) x 0.0005) / 10 = -1.060693. Fees are on the notional, so the short loses slightly more than the long (-1.059307): mirrored prices are not mirrored notionals.
